prompt: James notices a reference to "`db.example.com`" in the zone block of a BIND configuration file. What is the most likely purpose of this reference?
choices: It is the IP address of the example.com mail server.
It is a placeholder name for the zone file of example.com.
It is the TSIG key name used for example.com.
It is the hostname of the example.com slave server.
explanation: In a zone block the file value such as "`db.example.com`" names the zone data (database) file for the example.com domain.
